name: bilingual_es_en_2026_04_14
description: Cross-lingual recall test. Twelve events across six topics; each topic has one event written in Spanish and one in English describing the same underlying fact from a slightly different angle. Queries are deliberately asked in the OPPOSITE language of the event most likely to be relevant, so a system that only clusters intra-language will miss. Built 2026-04-14 to expose the multilingual calibration gap: merken's benchmarking is English-only but Jay's real daily content is mixed es/en. A pass here means the embedder + loop survive cross-lingual queries; a fail means the embedder (not the loop) is the bottleneck and the fix lives outside merken.

events.text: Detectamos que el consumer de Kafka en las pruebas de perf acumula lag cuando el throughput pasa de 3k msg/s porque el batch size quedo en 500 y el poll interval sigue en 100ms.
The perf Kafka consumer is falling behind because the default batch size of 500 plus a 100ms poll interval caps effective throughput well below the 3k msg/s producer rate.
El benchmarking de merken es solo en ingles, pero el contenido real de Jay es mezcla es/en, entonces el R@5 de 0.964 en LongMemEval puede no reflejar el comportamiento en produccion.
All external benchmarks for merken currently run in English only, which leaves cross-lingual retrieval quality uncalibrated despite the embedder being paraphrase-multilingual-capable.
El skill code-review postea comentarios en hilos separados en Azure DevOps y al final deja un resumen en el ticket de Jira enlazado al PR.
The code-review skill fetches the PR diff, runs a structured review via the code-reviewer subagent, threads comments back to Azure DevOps, and records a summary on the linked Jira ticket.
Cada PR de Pluxee se enlaza al ticket de Jira por el prefijo del branch (feature/ABC-123-...) y el skill usa ese patron para encontrar el ticket automaticamente.
Pluxee PR-to-Jira linking relies on branch name prefixes like feature/ABC-123; the skill parses the branch to find the ticket without needing an explicit argument.
vstash.SearchResult no expone tags ni layer directamente, asi que merken los mete en el campo title como workaround mientras esperamos el fix upstream.
The vstash public SearchResult object lacks tag and layer accessors, so merken encodes that metadata inside the title field until vstash ships a proper fix.
El proyecto se llamaba engram pero lo renombramos a merken y publicamos la 0.1.0 en PyPI el 2026-04-13.
Engram was renamed to merken before the first public release; merken 0.1.0 shipped to PyPI on 2026-04-13 under github.com/stffns/merken.
